name: com.hienadev.devtools
description: Editor tools for every project: Build All (Windows + Web builds in one click, zipped, with a build report and itch.io publishing), Perf Doctor (a plain-language profiler), Audio Trimmer (cut, fade and loop sounds), Game view screenshots and an Itch Page Kit (cover, screenshots, banner, GIF maker) a Web Size Tester, a Play toolbar, scene switcher, jam timer, Hierarchy notes/TODO and icons, folder colours, Find References, Bulk Rename, a Changelog, Missing Scripts, selection history and Favourites.

samples.description: A full cutscene editor: shots on a timeline, camera moves and looks (CCTV, VHS, thermal...), pop-ups, overlays, audio and events, with a live viewer. Window > Cinematic Editor once imported.

Make textures without a paint program: layered steps (make it loop, colour, dirt, pixel art, dithering, halftone, CRT, VHS, ink, painterly, mosaic, rust, moss and snow, cracks, scratches, drips, burns, warps, kaleidoscope, gradient maps, noise, wood, marble), maps (normal, height, AO, metal, curvature), patterns, decals, a Scene painter, and a Moving page: looping flipbooks (fire, smoke, caustics, lava, sparks, magic), flow maps and a shader maker for moving materials. Tools > Texture Studio once imported.

Build houses floor by floor in their own window: rooms of any shape, walls, doors, windows, stairs, railings, roofs and attics, your own models, walk mode, PSX look, prefabs, floor plans and NavMesh. Tools > Building Builder once imported. It uses Texture Studio, which is imported with it.

Fix models without Blender: decimate (like Blender's Decimate) and LODs, pivot, size and turning, normals, clean up, mirror, UVs, join and split, colliders, OBJ/FBX export, and PSX tools (triangle budget, light baked into vertex colours). Tools > Mesh Kit once imported.
